caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden object in the shape of an eagle’s head viewed from the side. The eagle’s head is rendered in brown shades, showing detailed texturing to represent the feathers, beak, and eye. The beak is curved and sharply pointed, with the upper beak overlapping the lower. The eye is round and prominent, set near the top portion of the head. The feathers are intricately carved and layered, especially along the back of the head, forming an elaborate pattern. The background is plain and a light cream color, with no other objects or decorations surrounding the eagle head. There is a small amount of handwritten text in the top right corner of the page. The composition centers the eagle’s head horizontally on the otherwise empty page.
title: Eagle: Billethead
